bio: Are you a fan of no-frills cuisine that stands out for its craftsmanship and flavour as well as the quality of its regional ingredients? In addition to classic Austrian fare such as Backhendl (breaded fried chicken), Wiener schnitzel etc, you can indulge in dishes such as fried lake trout with Mediterranean pearl barley and a Riesling foam, or roast lamb with Serviettenknödel (bread dumplings). Diners will appreciate the attentive, friendly service and cosy interior done out in a modern style and warm tones. The gorgeous wine cellar dates back to the 16C. Head for the terrace with a view of the Höllengebirge mountains....
